Items.TeacherExpectedMathematicsOrAssessmentMe: g(f(a))=a for a≥0; f(g(a))=a for a≥2. The former root yields |a| before imposing a≥0.

Items.FirstPartyStudentTask: Given f(x)=x²+2 for x≥0 and g(x)=√(x−2) for x≥2, compute f(g(11)) and g(f(11)), checking each intermediate input.

Items.FirstPartyStudentTask: Let S(d) be a health-safety monitoring score as a function of sensor input d, and m(t) the sensor reading after t minutes. Write the equation that finds when the score reaches 4.
Items.TeacherExpectedMathematicsOrAssessmentMe: Solve S(m(t))=4 for t. Other expression orders have incompatible quantity meanings.

Items.FirstPartyStudentTask: An item first receives a 30% discount and then a further 15% discount. Write the final price function of original price x with sequential composition.
Items.TeacherExpectedMathematicsOrAssessmentMe: P(x)=0.85(0.70x)=0.595x; total reduction is 40.5%, not 45%.

Items.TeacherExpectedMathematicsOrAssessmentMe: A(t)=π(2t+1)² m².
